newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish pension funds return average 15.4 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Irish pension funds return average 15.4 pct in '96.

text.p: Irish pension funds returned an average 15.4 percent in 1996 while the typical fund returned an average 2.5 percent in the last quarter, the latest survey by actuaries and benefit consultants Mercer Ltd showed on Friday.
Friends Provident emerged as the top performer of the 15 professional investment managers monitored in the survey, producing a return of 19 percent in 1996.
It was followed by Guardian Life and Eagle Star who produced returns of 17.3 percent compared with the average 15.4 percent.
Over a three-year period, ESB Fund Managers ranked first with an annualised return of 12.3 percent against an average of 9.1 percent.

Bank of Ireland was the top manager over the last five and 10-year periods, earning an annualised return of 14.6 percent and 13.6 percent against the average fund's 13.4 precent and 12.1 percent, Mercer said.

"1996 mirrored the previous year in that all major sectors, with the conspicuous exception of Japan, registered outstanding gains. However, adverse currency movements, particularly in Europe, dulled progress for many Irish investors," Mercer said.
